summary: Snapshot/apply durations are now emitted for every step by making step timings always include `apply_duration_ms` and `snapshot_duration_ms` (0 when not applicable) and recording zero-duration metrics on non-apply/snapshot paths. Step logs always contain those fields, and telemetry records them each step without adding labels.
notes: Updated `src/agent/loop.rs` to record zero-duration metrics for validation failures, done steps, and LLM/apply errors; `src/agent/memory.rs` to make timing fields non-optional; `src/output.rs` test helper updated. Added a note in `notes/2026-02-11-observ-001-snapshot-apply-metrics.md` and indexed it in `notes/index.md`.
